purpose: Name a control or related field group.
avoid: Do not infer association from visual proximity.
basis: Native source page 73:1978 (Label), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: The nonempty visible label text names the actual native control through for/id; placeholders do not replace it.
updatesAndDescendants: Label is a native label wrapper. Pointer activation delegates native focus to its associated control, while keyboard navigation targets the control itself. Text/for changes rerender normally; disabled appearance is styling, not a separate disabled label API.
referenceDecision: The reference chooses one explicit for/id relationship. A real native input must own that ID; custom controls use the corresponding primitive label integration.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Label is the actual native label wrapper, not an inferred FieldLabel primitive or automatic ARIA association. The source Label page itself depicts a FieldLabel instance from the same kit; its20px row and8px gap support the shared14/20px medium text and8px arrangement role. Optional field spacing and disabled opacity are explicitly caller context; no disabled prop is invented for Label. The host must bind htmlFor to a real labelable control and disable that control separately. Source instance widths are not runtime label widths. Logical layout supports RTL.
